snippet.title: Core Keeper - Riders of the Underground - Coming September 21st
snippet.description:
Giddy up, Explorers 🤠 Core Keeper’s 1.3 Update, Riders of the Underground, is coming on September 21st! 

This major content update marks the first stop on the Road to the Maw and brings with it a whole bunch of exciting new features including...

🤠 Rideable mounts
🌲 Moss sub-biome
🦖 Orex cattle
🔮  Mage & Summoner improvements
🐸 New pets
✨ And more!

Download on Steam: https://bit.ly/472ESAs 
Download on Nintendo Switch & Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/core-keeper-switch/
Download on PlayStation 5 & 4: https://www.playstation.com/en-gb/games/core-keeper/
Download on Xbox One and Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/core-keeper/9pkw4gmx4j8k
